mapper.sql: t.id, t.kind, t.business_id, t.business_version, t.requester_user_id, t.dedup_key, t.payload_json, t.stage_json, t.status, t.attempt, t.max_attempts, t.next_run_at, t.lease_token, t.lease_until, t.error_code, t.result_ref, t.expires_at, t.sent_at, t.create_time, t.update_time
mapper.select: select t.id from preg_task t where t.del_flag = '0' and t.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') and t.next_run_at <= #{now} and t.attempt < t.max_attempts order by t.next_run_at asc, t.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update preg_task set status = 'RUNNING', attempt = attempt + 1, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') and attempt < max_attempts and next_run_at <= #{now} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_task set stage_json = #{stageJson}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and lease_until > #{now} and del_flag = '0'

update preg_task set business_version = #{businessVersion}, payload_json = coalesce(#{payloadJson}, payload_json), next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') and del_flag = '0'
update preg_task set lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and lease_until > #{now}
mapper.select: select from preg_task t where t.id = #{id} and t.del_flag = '0'
select from preg_task t where t.dedup_key = #{dedupKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into preg_task ( kind, business_id, business_version, requester_user_id, dedup_key, payload_json, stage_json, status, attempt, max_attempts, next_run_at, del_flag, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{kind}, #{businessId}, #{businessVersion}, #{requesterUserId}, #{dedupKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{stageJson}, #{status}, 0, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRunAt}, '0', now(3), now(3) )
mapper.update: update preg_task set status = #{status}, stage_json = coalesce(#{stageJson}, stage_json), result_ref = #{resultRef}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, lease_token = null, lease_until = null, error_code = null, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and lease_until > #{now} and del_flag = '0'

update preg_task set status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, attempt = #{attempt}, max_attempts = #{maxAttempts}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, stage_json = coalesce(#{stageJson}, stage_json), lease_token = null, lease_until = null, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and lease_until > #{now} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_task set max_attempts = #{maxAttempts}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'

update preg_task set status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_token = null, lease_until = null, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'RUNNING')

update preg_task set status = 'CANCELLED', lease_token = null, lease_until = null, update_time = now(3) where kind = #{kind} and business_id = #{businessId} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
mapper.select: select from preg_task t where t.status = 'RUNNING' and t.lease_until <= #{now} and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update preg_task set status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_token = null, lease_until = null, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and lease_until <= #{now} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select from preg_task t where t.kind = 'EXPORT' and t.requester_user_id = #{requesterUserId} and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.id desc
select from preg_task t where t.kind = #{kind} and t.business_id = #{businessId} and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.id desc limit 1
select from preg_task t where t.kind = 'REMINDER' and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update preg_task set result_ref = null, update_time = now(3) where kind = 'EXPORT' and status = 'SUCCEEDED' and result_ref is not null and expires_at is not null and expires_at <= #{now} and del_flag = '0'
